Lomanto Junior writes:
        - Commander Inácio Silvestre dos Santos, of the BADIA company,
      who was operating the aircraft with the call sign PP-SDI, on a Rio-S.
      Paulo air bridge flight on December 18, 1965 at 20:30, observed
      over Gunnarah a luminous, spherical object emitting clear blue light.
      The strange craft, which accompanied the aircraft for approximately
      one minute before disappearing at incredible speed, was also seen by
      Governor Lomanto Júnior of Ba
